import { z } from 'zod';
import {
  FhirIdSchema,
  FhirDateSchema,
  FhirDateTimeSchema,
  FhirInstantSchema,
  CodeableConceptSchema,
  IdentifierSchema,
  ReferenceSchema,
  ExtensionSchema,
  MetaSchema,
  NarrativeSchema,
  QuantitySchema,
  PeriodSchema,
  type CodeableConcept,
  type Reference,
  type Extension,
  type Meta,
  type Narrative,
  type Quantity,
  type Period
} from './fhir-common';

/**
 * OBSERVATION RESOURCE
 * 
 * Measurements and simple assertions made about a patient, device or other subject.
 * 
 * Patterns from Synthea data:
 * - Most common resource type (720 instances in sample)
 * - Always has: id, status, category, code, subject, encounter, effectiveDateTime, issued
 * - Optional: meta, valueQuantity, valueCodeableConcept, component
 * - Categories: mostly "procedure", "vital-signs", "laboratory", "survey"
 * - Codes: LOINC system predominantly
 * - Values: Either valueQuantity (with units) or valueCodeableConcept
 * - Component: Used for multi-part observations (e.g., blood pressure)
 */

// Observation status codes
export const ObservationStatusSchema = z.enum([
  'registered', 'preliminary', 'final', 'amended', 'corrected', 'cancelled', 
  'entered-in-error', 'unknown'
]).describe('registered | preliminary | final | amended | corrected | cancelled | entered-in-error | unknown');

// Observation component for multi-part observations
export const ObservationComponentSchema = z.object({
  code: CodeableConceptSchema.describe('Type of component observation (code / type)'),
  
  // Value can be various types - most common in dataset
  valueQuantity: QuantitySchema.optional(),
  valueCodeableConcept: CodeableConceptSchema.optional(),
  valueString: z.string().optional(),
  valueBoolean: z.boolean().optional(),
  valueInteger: z.number().int().optional(),
  valueRange: z.object({
    low: QuantitySchema.optional(),
    high: QuantitySchema.optional()
  }).optional(),
  valueRatio: z.object({
    numerator: QuantitySchema.optional(),
    denominator: QuantitySchema.optional()
  }).optional(),
  valueSampledData: z.object({
    origin: QuantitySchema.describe('Zero value and units'),
    period: z.number().describe('Number of milliseconds between samples'),
    factor: z.number().optional().describe('Multiply data by this before adding to origin'),
    lowerLimit: z.number().optional().describe('Lower limit of detection'),
    upperLimit: z.number().optional().describe('Upper limit of detection'),
    dimensions: z.number().int().positive().describe('Number of sample points at each time point'),
    data: z.string().optional().describe('Decimal values with spaces, or "E" | "U" | "L"')
  }).optional(),
  valueTime: z.string().optional(),
  valueDateTime: FhirDateTimeSchema.optional(),
  valuePeriod: PeriodSchema.optional(),
  
  dataAbsentReason: CodeableConceptSchema.optional()
    .describe('Why the component result is missing'),
  
  interpretation: z.array(CodeableConceptSchema).optional()
    .describe('High, low, normal, etc.'),
  
  referenceRange: z.array(z.object({
    low: QuantitySchema.optional(),
    high: QuantitySchema.optional(),
    type: CodeableConceptSchema.optional(),
    appliesTo: z.array(CodeableConceptSchema).optional(),
    age: z.object({
      low: QuantitySchema.optional(),
      high: QuantitySchema.optional()
    }).optional(),
    text: z.string().optional()
  })).optional().describe('Provides guide for interpretation of component result')
});

export const ObservationSchema = z.object({
  resourceType: z.literal('Observation').describe('FHIR Resource Type'),
  
  id: FhirIdSchema.describe('Logical id of this artifact'),
  
  meta: MetaSchema.optional().describe('Metadata about the resource'),
  
  implicitRules: z.string().url().optional(),
  language: z.string().optional(),
  text: NarrativeSchema.optional(),
  contained: z.array(z.any()).optional(),
  extension: z.array(ExtensionSchema).optional(),
  modifierExtension: z.array(ExtensionSchema).optional(),
  
  identifier: z.array(IdentifierSchema).optional()
    .describe('Business Identifier for observation'),
  
  basedOn: z.array(ReferenceSchema).optional()
    .describe('Fulfills plan, proposal or order'),
  
  partOf: z.array(ReferenceSchema).optional()
    .describe('Part of referenced event'),
  
  status: ObservationStatusSchema
    .describe('Status of the result value'),
  
  category: z.array(CodeableConceptSchema)
    .describe('Classification of type of observation'),
  
  code: CodeableConceptSchema
    .describe('Type of observation (code / type)'),
  
  subject: ReferenceSchema.optional()
    .describe('Who and/or what the observation is about'),
  
  focus: z.array(ReferenceSchema).optional()
    .describe('What the observation is about, when it is not about the subject'),
  
  encounter: ReferenceSchema.optional()
    .describe('Healthcare event during which this observation is made'),
  
  // Timing of the observation
  effectiveDateTime: FhirDateTimeSchema.optional(),
  effectivePeriod: PeriodSchema.optional(),
  effectiveTiming: z.any().optional(), // Complex timing structure
  effectiveInstant: FhirInstantSchema.optional(),
  
  issued: FhirInstantSchema.optional()
    .describe('Date/Time this version was made available'),
  
  performer: z.array(ReferenceSchema).optional()
    .describe('Who is responsible for the observation'),
  
  // Value of the observation - can be various types
  valueQuantity: QuantitySchema.optional(),
  valueCodeableConcept: CodeableConceptSchema.optional(),
  valueString: z.string().optional(),
  valueBoolean: z.boolean().optional(),
  valueInteger: z.number().int().optional(),
  valueRange: z.object({
    low: QuantitySchema.optional(),
    high: QuantitySchema.optional()
  }).optional(),
  valueRatio: z.object({
    numerator: QuantitySchema.optional(),
    denominator: QuantitySchema.optional()
  }).optional(),
  valueSampledData: z.object({
    origin: QuantitySchema.describe('Zero value and units'),
    period: z.number().describe('Number of milliseconds between samples'),
    factor: z.number().optional(),
    lowerLimit: z.number().optional(),
    upperLimit: z.number().optional(),
    dimensions: z.number().int().positive(),
    data: z.string().optional()
  }).optional(),
  valueTime: z.string().optional(),
  valueDateTime: FhirDateTimeSchema.optional(),
  valuePeriod: PeriodSchema.optional(),
  
  dataAbsentReason: CodeableConceptSchema.optional()
    .describe('Why the result is missing'),
  
  interpretation: z.array(CodeableConceptSchema).optional()
    .describe('High, low, normal, etc.'),
  
  note: z.array(z.object({
    authorReference: ReferenceSchema.optional(),
    authorString: z.string().optional(),
    time: FhirDateTimeSchema.optional(),
    text: z.string().describe('The annotation - text content (as markdown)')
  })).optional().describe('Comments about the observation'),
  
  bodySite: CodeableConceptSchema.optional()
    .describe('Observed body part'),
  
  method: CodeableConceptSchema.optional()
    .describe('How it was done'),
  
  specimen: ReferenceSchema.optional()
    .describe('Specimen used for this observation'),
  
  device: ReferenceSchema.optional()
    .describe('(Measurement) Device'),
  
  referenceRange: z.array(z.object({
    low: QuantitySchema.optional(),
    high: QuantitySchema.optional(),
    type: CodeableConceptSchema.optional(),
    appliesTo: z.array(CodeableConceptSchema).optional(),
    age: z.object({
      low: QuantitySchema.optional(),
      high: QuantitySchema.optional()
    }).optional(),
    text: z.string().optional()
  })).optional().describe('Provides guide for interpretation'),
  
  hasMember: z.array(ReferenceSchema).optional()
    .describe('Related resource that belongs to the Observation group'),
  
  derivedFrom: z.array(ReferenceSchema).optional()
    .describe('Related measurements the observation is made from'),
  
  component: z.array(ObservationComponentSchema).optional()
    .describe('Component results')
});

/**
 * CONDITION RESOURCE
 * 
 * A clinical condition, problem, diagnosis, or other event, situation, issue, or clinical concept.
 * 
 * Patterns from Synthea data:
 * - All have: id, meta, clinicalStatus, verificationStatus, category, code, subject, encounter
 * - All have: onsetDateTime, recordedDate
 * - Optional: abatementDateTime (for resolved conditions)
 * - Categories: mostly "encounter-diagnosis"
 * - Codes: SNOMED CT system
 * - Clinical status: "active" or "resolved"
 * - Verification status: "confirmed"
 */

// Condition clinical status codes
export const ConditionClinicalStatusSchema = z.enum([
  'active', 'recurrence', 'relapse', 'inactive', 'remission', 'resolved'
]).describe('active | recurrence | relapse | inactive | remission | resolved');

// Condition verification status codes
export const ConditionVerificationStatusSchema = z.enum([
  'unconfirmed', 'provisional', 'differential', 'confirmed', 'refuted', 'entered-in-error'
]).describe('unconfirmed | provisional | differential | confirmed | refuted | entered-in-error');

export const ConditionSchema = z.object({
  resourceType: z.literal('Condition').describe('FHIR Resource Type'),
  
  id: FhirIdSchema.describe('Logical id of this artifact'),
  
  meta: MetaSchema.optional().describe('Metadata about the resource'),
  
  implicitRules: z.string().url().optional(),
  language: z.string().optional(),
  text: NarrativeSchema.optional(),
  contained: z.array(z.any()).optional(),
  extension: z.array(ExtensionSchema).optional(),
  modifierExtension: z.array(ExtensionSchema).optional(),
  
  identifier: z.array(IdentifierSchema).optional()
    .describe('External Ids for this condition'),
  
  clinicalStatus: z.object({
    coding: z.array(z.object({
      system: z.string().optional(),
      code: ConditionClinicalStatusSchema.optional(),
      display: z.string().optional()
    })).optional()
  }).optional().describe('active | recurrence | relapse | inactive | remission | resolved'),
  
  verificationStatus: z.object({
    coding: z.array(z.object({
      system: z.string().optional(),
      code: ConditionVerificationStatusSchema.optional(),
      display: z.string().optional()
    })).optional()
  }).optional().describe('unconfirmed | provisional | differential | confirmed | refuted | entered-in-error'),
  
  category: z.array(CodeableConceptSchema).optional()
    .describe('problem-list-item | encounter-diagnosis'),
  
  severity: CodeableConceptSchema.optional()
    .describe('Subjective severity of condition'),
  
  code: CodeableConceptSchema.optional()
    .describe('Identification of the condition, problem or diagnosis'),
  
  bodySite: z.array(CodeableConceptSchema).optional()
    .describe('Anatomical location, if relevant'),
  
  subject: ReferenceSchema
    .describe('Who has the condition?'),
  
  encounter: ReferenceSchema.optional()
    .describe('Encounter created as part of'),
  
  // Onset timing
  onsetDateTime: FhirDateTimeSchema.optional(),
  onsetAge: QuantitySchema.optional(),
  onsetPeriod: PeriodSchema.optional(),
  onsetRange: z.object({
    low: QuantitySchema.optional(),
    high: QuantitySchema.optional()
  }).optional(),
  onsetString: z.string().optional(),
  
  // Abatement timing
  abatementDateTime: FhirDateTimeSchema.optional(),
  abatementAge: QuantitySchema.optional(),
  abatementPeriod: PeriodSchema.optional(),
  abatementRange: z.object({
    low: QuantitySchema.optional(),
    high: QuantitySchema.optional()
  }).optional(),
  abatementString: z.string().optional(),
  
  recordedDate: FhirDateTimeSchema.optional()
    .describe('Date record was first recorded'),
  
  recorder: ReferenceSchema.optional()
    .describe('Who recorded the condition'),
  
  asserter: ReferenceSchema.optional()
    .describe('Person who asserts this condition'),
  
  stage: z.array(z.object({
    summary: CodeableConceptSchema.optional(),
    assessment: z.array(ReferenceSchema).optional(),
    type: CodeableConceptSchema.optional()
  })).optional().describe('Stage/grade, usually assessed formally'),
  
  evidence: z.array(z.object({
    code: z.array(CodeableConceptSchema).optional(),
    detail: z.array(ReferenceSchema).optional()
  })).optional().describe('Supporting evidence'),
  
  note: z.array(z.object({
    authorReference: ReferenceSchema.optional(),
    authorString: z.string().optional(),
    time: FhirDateTimeSchema.optional(),
    text: z.string().describe('The annotation - text content')
  })).optional().describe('Additional information about the Condition')
});

/**
 * PROCEDURE RESOURCE
 * 
 * An action that is or was performed on or for a patient.
 * 
 * Patterns from Synthea data:
 * - All have: id, meta, status, code, subject, encounter, performedPeriod, location
 * - Optional: reasonCode, reasonReference
 * - Status: "completed"
 * - Codes: SNOMED CT system
 * - Location: References to Location resources
 * - Timing: performedPeriod with start/end times
 */

// Procedure status codes
export const ProcedureStatusSchema = z.enum([
  'preparation', 'in-progress', 'not-done', 'on-hold', 'stopped', 'completed', 'entered-in-error', 'unknown'
]).describe('preparation | in-progress | not-done | on-hold | stopped | completed | entered-in-error | unknown');

export const ProcedureSchema = z.object({
  resourceType: z.literal('Procedure').describe('FHIR Resource Type'),
  
  id: FhirIdSchema.describe('Logical id of this artifact'),
  
  meta: MetaSchema.optional().describe('Metadata about the resource'),
  
  implicitRules: z.string().url().optional(),
  language: z.string().optional(),
  text: NarrativeSchema.optional(),
  contained: z.array(z.any()).optional(),
  extension: z.array(ExtensionSchema).optional(),
  modifierExtension: z.array(ExtensionSchema).optional(),
  
  identifier: z.array(IdentifierSchema).optional()
    .describe('External Identifiers for this procedure'),
  
  instantiatesCanonical: z.array(z.string()).optional()
    .describe('Instantiates FHIR protocol or definition'),
  
  instantiatesUri: z.array(z.string().url()).optional()
    .describe('Instantiates external protocol or definition'),
  
  basedOn: z.array(ReferenceSchema).optional()
    .describe('A request for this procedure'),
  
  partOf: z.array(ReferenceSchema).optional()
    .describe('Part of referenced event'),
  
  status: ProcedureStatusSchema
    .describe('Status of the procedure'),
  
  statusReason: CodeableConceptSchema.optional()
    .describe('Reason for current status'),
  
  category: CodeableConceptSchema.optional()
    .describe('Classification of the procedure'),
  
  code: CodeableConceptSchema.optional()
    .describe('Identification of the procedure'),
  
  subject: ReferenceSchema
    .describe('Who the procedure was performed on'),
  
  encounter: ReferenceSchema.optional()
    .describe('Encounter created as part of'),
  
  // Timing of the procedure
  performedDateTime: FhirDateTimeSchema.optional(),
  performedPeriod: PeriodSchema.optional(),
  performedString: z.string().optional(),
  performedAge: QuantitySchema.optional(),
  performedRange: z.object({
    low: QuantitySchema.optional(),
    high: QuantitySchema.optional()
  }).optional(),
  
  recorder: ReferenceSchema.optional()
    .describe('Who recorded the procedure'),
  
  asserter: ReferenceSchema.optional()
    .describe('Person who asserts this procedure'),
  
  performer: z.array(z.object({
    function: CodeableConceptSchema.optional(),
    actor: ReferenceSchema.describe('The reference to the practitioner'),
    onBehalfOf: ReferenceSchema.optional()
  })).optional().describe('The people who performed the procedure'),
  
  location: ReferenceSchema.optional()
    .describe('Where the procedure happened'),
  
  reasonCode: z.array(CodeableConceptSchema).optional()
    .describe('Coded reason procedure performed'),
  
  reasonReference: z.array(ReferenceSchema).optional()
    .describe('The justification that the procedure was performed'),
  
  bodySite: z.array(CodeableConceptSchema).optional()
    .describe('Target body sites'),
  
  outcome: CodeableConceptSchema.optional()
    .describe('The result of procedure'),
  
  report: z.array(ReferenceSchema).optional()
    .describe('Any report resulting from the procedure'),
  
  complication: z.array(CodeableConceptSchema).optional()
    .describe('Complication following the procedure'),
  
  complicationDetail: z.array(ReferenceSchema).optional()
    .describe('A condition that is a result of the procedure'),
  
  followUp: z.array(CodeableConceptSchema).optional()
    .describe('Instructions for follow up'),
  
  note: z.array(z.object({
    authorReference: ReferenceSchema.optional(),
    authorString: z.string().optional(),
    time: FhirDateTimeSchema.optional(),
    text: z.string().describe('The annotation - text content')
  })).optional().describe('Additional information about the procedure'),
  
  focalDevice: z.array(z.object({
    action: CodeableConceptSchema.optional(),

  usedReference: z.array(ReferenceSchema).optional()

  usedCode: z.array(CodeableConceptSchema).optional()

// Export types
export type Observation = z.infer<typeof ObservationSchema>;
export type ObservationComponent = z.infer<typeof ObservationComponentSchema>;
export type Condition = z.infer<typeof ConditionSchema>;

import { z } from 'zod';
import {
  FhirIdSchema,
  FhirDateTimeSchema,
  CodeableConceptSchema,
  IdentifierSchema,
  ReferenceSchema,
  ExtensionSchema,
  MetaSchema,
  NarrativeSchema,
  PeriodSchema,
  type CodeableConcept,
  type Reference,
  type Extension,
  type Meta,
  type Narrative,
  type Period,
  type Identifier
} from './fhir-common';

/**
 * ENCOUNTER RESOURCE
 * 
 * An interaction between a patient and healthcare provider(s) for the purpose of providing healthcare service(s).
 * 
 * Patterns from Synthea data:
 * - All have: id, meta, identifier, status, class, type, subject, participant, period, serviceProvider
 * - All have: location (array with location references)
 * - Optional: reasonCode (array of coded reasons)
 * - Status: "finished"
 * - Class: "AMB" (ambulatory)
 * - Type: SNOMED codes for encounter types
 * - Participant: Primary performer with period and practitioner reference
 * - Period: Start and end times
 * - Location: References to Location resources
 * - ServiceProvider: References to Organization resources
 */

// Encounter status codes
export const EncounterStatusSchema = z.enum([
  'planned', 'arrived', 'triaged', 'in-progress', 'onleave', 'finished', 'cancelled', 'entered-in-error', 'unknown'
]).describe('planned | arrived | triaged | in-progress | onleave | finished | cancelled | entered-in-error | unknown');

// Encounter class codes
export const EncounterClassSchema = z.object({
  system: z.string().describe('Identity of the terminology system'),
  code: z.string().describe('Symbol in syntax defined by the system'),
  display: z.string().optional().describe('Representation defined by the system')
});

// Encounter participant
export const EncounterParticipantSchema = z.object({
  type: z.array(CodeableConceptSchema).optional()
    .describe('Role of participant in encounter'),
  
  period: PeriodSchema.optional()
    .describe('Period of time during the encounter that the participant participated'),
  
  individual: ReferenceSchema.optional()
    .describe('Persons involved in the encounter other than the patient')
});

// Encounter location
export const EncounterLocationSchema = z.object({
  location: ReferenceSchema.describe('Location the encounter takes place'),
  
  status: z.enum(['planned', 'active', 'reserved', 'completed']).optional()
    .describe('planned | active | reserved | completed'),
  
  physicalType: CodeableConceptSchema.optional()
    .describe('The physical type of the location'),
  
  period: PeriodSchema.optional()
    .describe('Time period during which the patient was present at the location')
});

// Encounter status history
export const EncounterStatusHistorySchema = z.object({
  status: EncounterStatusSchema.describe('Status the encounter was in'),
  period: PeriodSchema.describe('The time that the episode was in the specified status')
});

// Encounter class history
export const EncounterClassHistorySchema = z.object({
  class: EncounterClassSchema.describe('inpatient | outpatient | ambulatory | emergency +'),
  period: PeriodSchema.describe('The time that the episode was in the specified class')
});

// Encounter diagnosis
export const EncounterDiagnosisSchema = z.object({
  condition: ReferenceSchema.describe('The diagnosis or procedure relevant to the encounter'),
  
  use: CodeableConceptSchema.optional()
    .describe('Role that this diagnosis has within the encounter'),
  
  rank: z.number().int().positive().optional()
    .describe('Ranking of the diagnosis (for each role type)')
});

// Encounter hospitalization
export const EncounterHospitalizationSchema = z.object({
  preAdmissionIdentifier: IdentifierSchema.optional()
    .describe('Pre-admission identifier'),
  
  origin: ReferenceSchema.optional()
    .describe('The location/organization from which the patient came before admission'),
  
  admitSource: CodeableConceptSchema.optional()
    .describe('From where patient was admitted'),
  
  reAdmission: CodeableConceptSchema.optional()
    .describe('The type of hospital re-admission'),
  
  dietPreference: z.array(CodeableConceptSchema).optional()
    .describe('Diet preferences reported by the patient'),
  
  specialCourtesy: z.array(CodeableConceptSchema).optional()
    .describe('Special courtesies'),
  
  specialArrangement: z.array(CodeableConceptSchema).optional()
    .describe('Wheelchair, translator, stretcher, etc.'),
  
  destination: ReferenceSchema.optional()
    .describe('Location/organization to which the patient is discharged'),
  
  dischargeDisposition: CodeableConceptSchema.optional()
    .describe('Category or kind of location after discharge')
});

export const EncounterSchema = z.object({
  resourceType: z.literal('Encounter').describe('FHIR Resource Type'),
  
  id: FhirIdSchema.describe('Logical id of this artifact'),
  
  meta: MetaSchema.optional().describe('Metadata about the resource'),
  
  implicitRules: z.string().url().optional(),
  language: z.string().optional(),
  text: NarrativeSchema.optional(),
  contained: z.array(z.any()).optional(),
  extension: z.array(ExtensionSchema).optional(),
  modifierExtension: z.array(ExtensionSchema).optional(),
  
  identifier: z.array(IdentifierSchema).optional()
    .describe('Identifier(s) by which this encounter is known'),
  
  status: EncounterStatusSchema
    .describe('Status of the encounter'),
  
  statusHistory: z.array(EncounterStatusHistorySchema).optional()
    .describe('List of past encounter statuses'),
  
  class: EncounterClassSchema
    .describe('Classification of patient encounter'),
  
  classHistory: z.array(EncounterClassHistorySchema).optional()
    .describe('List of past encounter classes'),
  
  type: z.array(CodeableConceptSchema).optional()
    .describe('Specific type of encounter'),
  
  serviceType: CodeableConceptSchema.optional()
    .describe('Specific type of service'),
  
  priority: CodeableConceptSchema.optional()
    .describe('Indicates the urgency of the encounter'),
  
  subject: ReferenceSchema.optional()
    .describe('The patient or group present at the encounter'),
  
  episodeOfCare: z.array(ReferenceSchema).optional()
    .describe('Episode(s) of care that this encounter should be recorded against'),
  
  basedOn: z.array(ReferenceSchema).optional()
    .describe('The ServiceRequest that initiated this encounter'),
  
  participant: z.array(EncounterParticipantSchema).optional()
    .describe('List of participants involved in the encounter'),
  
  appointment: z.array(ReferenceSchema).optional()
    .describe('The appointment that scheduled this encounter'),
  
  period: PeriodSchema.optional()
    .describe('The start and end time of the encounter'),
  
  length: z.object({
    value: z.number().optional(),
    unit: z.string().optional(),
    system: z.string().optional(),
    code: z.string().optional()
